title: A Blinded Randomized Clinical Study of RefluxStop™ Compared With Nissen Fundoplication in the Treatment of GERD
official: A Blinded Randomized Clinical Investigation of RefluxStop™ Compared With Nissen Fundoplication in the Treatment of Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD).
summary: This study will evaluate if the RefluxStop™ device will treat your acid reflux and improve your symptoms and how it compares to the standard surgical treatment for GERD, the Nissen fundoplication.
